title: Multi-Head Self-Attention
signature: def multi_head_attention(x, W_q, W_k, W_v, W_o, num_heads, mask=None) -> np.ndarray
hints: Project first: Q = x @ W_q has shape (B, T, d_model). Then split the last axis into (num_heads, d_head).
reshape(B, T, h, d_head) followed by transpose(0, 2, 1, 3) gives (B, h, T, d_head). Reshaping straight to (B, h, T, d_head) scrambles tokens and heads.
Scale the scores by 1 / sqrt(d_head), not 1 / sqrt(d_model).
To merge, transpose back to (B, T, h, d_head), reshape to (B, T, d_model), then multiply by W_o.
